metadata.name: Obsidian Orb
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A battle station built from the Orbital Station style pack and painted gunmetal grey. Grey grated corridors ring a bottomless reactor shaft whose four bridges retract from their consoles (strand whoever is chasing you), out to the reactor control in the middle. A hangar of skyfighters and a shuttle behind a force field; a trash compactor whose walls grind in on a timer; a detention block of team-locked cells; a tractor-beam pylon reached by narrow catwalks over the drop, where cutting the power coupling drops the hangar field; a dark throne room with a wall of windows onto the stars. Through the airlock, a long metal trench on the surface in low gravity, turret emplacements along its walls and the exhaust port at the end.

do.text: Obsidian Orb. Mind the shafts: they have no bottom.
